verdict.rationale: Verifying security and compliance posture is a fair question for a cloud GPU/serverless provider like Modal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers SOC 2, data handling, security documentation, a trust center or datacenter tiers. The items cover only GPU selection, pricing, SDKs and observability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it
